# Entity tools

Create, read, change, move, duplicate and delete entities; read component schemas.

10 tools in the `entity` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`entity_get`](#entity_get) | Full data of one entity: components (all fields), tags, vars, behaviors (intent + Wander source). |
| [`entity_create`](#entity_create) | Create an entity. |
| [`entity_update`](#entity_update) | Change an entity. |
| [`transform`](#transform) | Move/rotate/scale an entity. |
| [`entity_delete`](#entity_delete) | Delete an entity and all its children (undoable). |
| [`entity_duplicate`](#entity_duplicate) | Copy an entity (with children, components and behaviors). |
| [`component_schema`](#component_schema) | JSON schema of components (transform, mesh, light, camera) and the environment, with field docs, ranges and enums. |
| [`entity_refs`](#entity_refs) | Who references an entity and what it references (joint targets, camera follow, look-at, bone attachments, IK, groom/particle colliders...). |
| [`entity_copy`](#entity_copy) | Copy entities (with children) to a clipboard document for entity_paste — in this scene or after scene_load in another. |
| [`entity_paste`](#entity_paste) | Create copies of a clipboard document from entity_copy. |

### `entity_get` { #entity_get }

**Get entity** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Full data of one entity: components (all fields), tags, vars, behaviors (intent + Wander source).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer \| string | yes | Entity id (number) or exact name |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_get {"entity": "Player"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_get '{"entity": "Player"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_get",
        "arguments": {
          "entity": "Player"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_create` { #entity_create }

**Create entity** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Create an entity. Shorthands: mesh (primitive name), color, position, rotation (degrees), scale. `components` takes full component objects, e.g. {"light": {"kind": "point", "intensity": 3}}. Returns the new id.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Display name |  |
| `parent` | integer \| string |  | Parent entity (id or name) |  |
| `mesh` | string |  | Primitive: cube, sphere, plane, cylinder, cone, quad, capsule, torus |  |
| `color` | string |  | Base color "#rrggbb" |  |
| `position` | number[3] |  | Position [x, y, z] in meters |  |
| `rotation` | number[3] |  | Rotation [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees |  |
| `scale` | number[3] |  | Scale [x, y, z] |  |
| `tags` | string[] |  | Tags |  |
| `vars` | object |  | Free-form entity variables |  |
| `components` | object |  | Component name -&gt; fields |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_create {"name": "Street", "mesh": "plane", "color": "#1a1c22", "scale": [40, 1, 40], "components": {"mesh": {"roughness": 0.12}}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_create '{"name": "Street", "mesh": "plane", "color": "#1a1c22", "scale": [40, 1, 40], "components": {"mesh": {"roughness": 0.12}}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_create",
        "arguments": {
          "name": "Street",
          "mesh": "plane",
          "color": "#1a1c22",
          "scale": [
            40,
            1,
            40
          ],
          "components": {
            "mesh": {
              "roughness": 0.12
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_update` { #entity_update }

**Update entity** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Change an entity. Only given keys change; component objects are merged field-by-field. Set a component to null to remove it. Example: {"entity": "Lamp", "components": {"light": {"intensity": 5}}}.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer \| string | yes | Entity id (number) or exact name |  |
| `name` | string |  | New name |  |
| `parent` | integer \| string |  | New parent (0 for root) |  |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Enable/disable |  |
| `tags` | string[] |  | Replace tags |  |
| `vars` | object |  | Merge into vars (null deletes) |  |
| `unique` | boolean |  | Unique name in its prefab instance / scene: Wander find("%Name") finds it |  |
| `components` | object |  | Component name -&gt; partial fields |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Lamp", "components": {"light": {"intensity": 5}}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_update '{"entity": "Lamp", "components": {"light": {"intensity": 5}}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_update",
        "arguments": {
          "entity": "Lamp",
          "components": {
            "light": {
              "intensity": 5
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `transform` { #transform }

**Transform entity** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Move/rotate/scale an entity. Absolute: position, rotation (degrees), scale. Relative: translate, rotate. space=world interprets position in world space even if the entity has a parent.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer \| string | yes | Entity id (number) or exact name |  |
| `position` | number[3] |  | Absolute position |  |
| `rotation` | number[3] |  | Absolute rotation, degrees |  |
| `scale` | number[3] |  | Absolute scale |  |
| `translate` | number[3] |  | Relative offset |  |
| `rotate` | number[3] |  | Relative rotation, degrees |  |
| `space` | string |  | Space for `position` (default local) | `local` `world` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    transform {"entity": "Crate", "position": [2, 0.5, -3], "rotation": [0, 45, 0]}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call transform '{"entity": "Crate", "position": [2, 0.5, -3], "rotation": [0, 45, 0]}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "transform",
        "arguments": {
          "entity": "Crate",
          "position": [
            2,
            0.5,
            -3
          ],
          "rotation": [
            0,
            45,
            0
          ]
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_duplicate` { #entity_duplicate }

**Duplicate entity** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Copy an entity (with children, components and behaviors). Optional new name and position offset. `entities` duplicates several together: links between them (joint targets, look-at, follow...) point at the copies, so a duplicated rig stays wired to itself. Prefab instances stay linked.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer \| string |  | Entity id (number) or exact name |  |
| `entities` | integer \| string[] |  | Several entities duplicated as one group |  |
| `name` | string |  | Name of the copy (single entity) |  |
| `offset` | number[3] |  | Offset added to the copy's position |  |
| `count` | integer |  | Number of copies (default 1, max 100); offsets accumulate |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_duplicate {"entity": "Lamp", "name": "Lamp Row", "offset": [3, 0, 0], "count": 4}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_duplicate '{"entity": "Lamp", "name": "Lamp Row", "offset": [3, 0, 0], "count": 4}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_duplicate",
        "arguments": {
          "entity": "Lamp",
          "name": "Lamp Row",
          "offset": [
            3,
            0,
            0
          ],
          "count": 4
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_refs` { #entity_refs }

**Entity references** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Who references an entity and what it references (joint targets, camera follow, look-at, bone attachments, IK, groom/particle colliders...). Links store the target's id plus its name, so they survive renames. Without `entity`: a scene-wide health check listing dangling links (pointing at nothing), links that only resolve by name (fragile), duplicate unique names and broken prefab instances, each with a fix. Example: {"entity": "Door"} before renaming or deleting it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | integer \| string |  | Entity to inspect; omit for the scene-wide check |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max problems listed (default 50) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_refs {"entity": "Door"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_refs '{"entity": "Door"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_refs",
        "arguments": {
          "entity": "Door"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_copy` { #entity_copy }

**Copy entities** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Copy entities (with children) to a clipboard document for entity_paste — in this scene or after scene_load in another. Links between copied entities and prefab instances inside the copy are kept.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | integer \| string[] | yes | Entities to copy (their children come along) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_copy {"entities": [1]}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_copy '{"entities": [1]}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_copy",
        "arguments": {
          "entities": [
            1
          ]
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `entity_paste` { #entity_paste }

**Paste entities** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Create copies of a clipboard document from entity_copy. Links among the pasted entities point at the new copies (a pasted rig stays wired to itself); links to other entities keep their target; prefab instances stay linked. Optional parent and position offset.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | object | yes | The clipboard document from entity_copy |  |
| `parent` | integer \| string |  | Parent of the pasted roots (default: none) |  |
| `offset` | number[3] |  | Added to each pasted root's position |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_paste {"data": {}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call entity_paste '{"data": {}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "entity_paste",
        "arguments": {
          "data": {}
        }
      }
    }
    ```
